publication_scope: Exactly two frozen manuscript PDFs, this release description, and its file manifest; no research code or raw data.
conservative_scope: Local positive-phase-volume KAM tori for every finite real coefficient of the fixed-source-quadratic, zero-cubic, one-parameter A-squared family; no uniform numerical radius or general 42-coefficient conclusion.
joint_observation_scope: One common c in [-1e-15,0] simultaneously satisfies the unchanged first-four-cell observation balls for all 22 signed saved-state IVPs; not a fit to all 257 raw samples.

executed_weak_row_scope.normalization: Original weak-row units before division by ds; not continuous residual work.

source_prefix_theorem_scope: All-prefix residual-work bound under an explicit global scalar constitutive prior, its nonzero-force-loss-admitted parameter interval, the same native full mass and magnetic port, an independent positive viscosity lower prior, and a bound on every actual input-supply prefix. Source energy establishes the domain before candidate damping is estimated.

original_22_source_IVP_scope.initial_conditions: The 22 own saved numerical full64 initial states.
original_22_source_IVP_scope.horizons: Each own original binary64 saved horizon near 20 microseconds, all continuous prefixes.
original_22_source_IVP_scope.input: Whole-law exact-decimal cosine amplitude 1e-4 T, not sampled-node inference.

recorded_three_hold_source_scope.initial_condition: The recorded reference history own saved seed; no replacement with a training initial state.
